head: codex/4646-v0917-external-review
title: [v0.91.7][WP-19] Prepare exact-revision external review handoff
body:
Refs #4646

## Summary
- reconcile current v0.91.7 milestone, sprint, remediation, and v0.91.8 bridge truth
- define one authoritative 29-entry publication-safe review corpus
- separate immutable target identity from the corpus through a non-self-referential dispatch receipt
- retain PR #5574 as the only transient stable-corpus send hold and #5571 as a disclosed v0.91.8 residual

## Validation
- `git diff --check`
- v0.91.7 issue-wave YAML parse
- 29 manifest entries, 66 tracked files, no duplicates or excluded-path overlap
- publication-safety and changed-document link scans
- exact-revision subagent review: pass after three findings fixed
- C-SDLC v2 doctor: pass

External review has not run and this PR does not close #4646 or approve release readiness.
